attractions.name: And Now for Something Completely Different

events.name: The Will Aldrich Trio
events.info: THE WILL ALDRICH TRIO Will Aldrich - saxophone Cypress Proctor - drums Nick Doan - bass Hailing from Minnesota, saxophonist Will Aldrich is a passionate multi-instrumentalist, arranger, and composer who excels in jazz tradition. He has played numerous shows in the North-East Ohio area, in the Twin Cities, and in Seattle including an opening set for Wynton Marsalis at Orchestra Hall in Minneapolis, multiple performances at the Twin Cities Jazz Fest, the Taste of Minnesota, and performances at a host of jazz clubs, restaurants, bars, and more. He is a saxophonist looking to push boundaries between jazz, hip-hop, and other styles while maintaining a deep understanding and respect for the history of jazz music. Currently studying Jazz Performance at Oberlin Conservatory in Ohio, Will studies with 2024 NEA Jazz Master Gary Bartz as well as with master bass player Gerald Cannon, Grammy award winning pianist Luis Perdomo, among other acclaimed faculty. Will is also an alum of the illustrious Walker West Music Academy in Saint Paul, studying under all its faculty including Kavyesh Kaviraj, Kevin E. Washington, Ted Olson, Jack Breen, and many more. Will and the Roof Access band unanimously placed 1st in the 2023 Eau Jazz Festival and have conducted many shows across the Cities showcasing their unique fusion of classic swing, hip-hop, modern jazz, and Afro-Latin influences. Their debut album , "rdquo" -> Roof Access" featuring originals by Will Aldrich, Ataa Mensah, Rafi Karpowitz, and Callum Schultz is now available on CD and on all streaming platforms.

events.info: Skyrie is a Neo-trad Scottish trio who blend Scottish and Irish traditional songs, poignant original songs, dance tunes and soundscapes with modern influences from rock to funk. Having performed and recorded over many years with multi award-winning artists as diverse as renowned Scottish singer songwriter Dougie MacLean, Shirley Manson of Garbage, Big Country and Kathy Mattea, they have performed at diverse events such as the world-renowned Celtic Connections festival in Glasgow and the Dundee New Year Hooley and in such diverse places as Budapest, Cyprus, and the British Embassy in Kuwait.

events.name: Swing Dance with Bent String
events.info: We're excited for a great night of music and dancing at The Land Lindy Hop's Second Friday Swing Dance - this time with Bent String! Doors Open: 6:45pm Beginner Lesson: 7:00pm Band Plays: 7:30 - 10:30pm You'll love dancing to this group centered on the vocals of Kari Ann Rutushin and underpinned with the feel of jazz-age swing. Bent String also features Reed Simon's hot violin, Kevin Richards' arch-top guitars, Rich Roberts on percussion, and Cleveland Blues Hall of Fame upright bassist, Raymond DeForest. We'll be in the Music Hall at the Treelawn, which features a large wooden dance floor, air conditioning, and drinks available for purchase. We'll start the night with a 30 minute beginner dance lesson, then Bent String will take the stage! Entry for the entire event is $22 at the door (cash, Venmo, Paypal, or Zelle). No pre-registration required. Come join The Land Lindy Hop for a great night of LIVE music suitable for Lindy Hop, Charleston, Balboa, and more at the historic Treelawn Music Hall. All are welcome! No partner or experience necessary! Free parking is available in the adjacent lot, as well as on surrounding streets. MORE INFO: https://www.facebook.com/events/1466951362221488/?acontext=%7B%22ref%22%3A%2252%22%2C%22action_history%22%3A%22[%7B%5C%22surface%5C%22%3A%5C%22share_link%5C%22%2C%5C%22mechanism%5C%22%3A%5C%22share_link%5C%22%2C%5C%22extra_data%5C%22%3A%7B%5C%22invite_link_id%5C%22%3A1484749866821437%7D%7D]%22%7D
